name: anon-1b
description: anon-1b is a full fine-tune of google/gemma-3-1b-pt on 157,342 greentext stories. The stories were OCR'd from screenshots posted to r/greentext, r/4chan, r/4tran and r/classic4chan. Generation can be conditioned on the source subreddit and a score bucket, and either one can be left out. The data was not content-filtered. It was built to explore content-specific base models for looming, and whether a small base model can be trained to produce genuinely funny output.
